AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c0_.text: Apple Inc. reported total consolidated net sales of $383,285 million ($383.28B) with gross profit of $169,148 million, representing an overall gross margin of 44.1%. Product net sales (iPhone, Mac, iPad, Wearables) generated $298,085 million, while Services revenue (App Store, Apple Music, iCloud, ApplePay) reached an all-time record of $85,200 million.

metadata.section: Section 1: Executive Financial Performance and Income Statement Summary

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c1_.text: Total operating expenses were $54,847 million, comprising $29,915 million in Research & Development (R&D) and $24,932 million in SG&A. Consolidated operating income stood at $114,301 million, yielding net income of $96,995 million ($6.13 diluted EPS). Total assets stood at $352,583 million.

metadata.section: Section 1: Executive Financial Performance and Income Statement Summary

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c2_.text: Total assets stood at $352,583 million. Current assets included $29,965 million in Cash and cash equivalents, $31,590 million in Marketable securities, $29,508 million in Accounts receivable, and $6,331 million in Inventories. Current liabilities totaled $145,308 million, including $62,610 million in Accounts payable and $7,995 million in Deferred revenue. Non-current liabilities included $95,281 million in Long-term term debt.

metadata.section: Section 2: Balance Sheet, Working Capital and Liquidity Disclosures

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c3_.text: Non-current liabilities included $95,281 million in Long-term term debt. Total shareholders equity stood at $62,146 million. Revenue is recognized when control of promised goods or services is transferred to customers. Under ASC 606, hardware sales with bundled software updates are accounted for as multiple performance obligations with transaction prices allocated on a relative standalone selling price (SSP) basis.

metadata.section: Section 2: Balance Sheet, Working Capital and Liquidity Disclosures

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c4_.text: R&D costs are expensed as incurred. Inventories are stated at the lower of cost or net realizable value (NRV) using the first-in, first-out (FIFO) method.

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c0.text: Amazon reported net sales of $574,785 million ($574.79B), an increase of 12% year-over-year. North America segment sales were $352,828 million with operating income of $14,877 million. International segment contributed $131,200 million in net sales. Amazon Web Services (AWS) delivered $90,757 million in revenue with an operating margin of 27.1% ($24,631 million in AWS operating income), remaining the primary profit engine.

metadata.section: Section 1: Consolidated Revenue, AWS Segment and Operating Margins

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c1.text: Consolidated worldwide operating income reached $36,852 million, yielding net income of $30,425 million ($2.90 diluted EPS). Operating cash flow grew 82% to $84,946 million. Free cash flow swung positive to $36,810 million compared to negative $11,595 million in the prior period. Total assets stood at $527,854 million.

metadata.section: Section 2: Cash Flow Generation, Fulfillment Infrastructure and Capital Leases

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c2.text: Total assets stood at $527,854 million. Property and equipment net reached $203,788 million, reflecting investments in automated fulfillment centers and AWS server clusters. Lease liabilities under ASC 842 totaled $77,411 million (finance and operating leases for warehouse facilities and aircraft). Retail product sales are recognized upon shipment or customer delivery.

metadata.section: Section 2: Cash Flow Generation, Fulfillment Infrastructure and Capital Leases

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c3.text: Retail product sales are recognized upon shipment or customer delivery. Third-party seller services and Amazon Advertising ($46,906 million revenue) are recognized as services are rendered or upon ad click impressions. Useful lives for servers were extended to five years, reducing annual depreciation expense by approximately $4.4 billion.

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Microsoft Corporation achieved total annual revenue of $245,120 million ($245.12B), an increase of 16% year-over-year. Gross margin reached $168,590 million (68.8% gross margin). Intelligent Cloud segment (Azure, Windows Server, SQL Server) led revenue generation with $105,360 million, driven by 30% growth in Azure and cloud infrastructure services.

metadata.section: Section 1: Segment Operations and Income Statement Breakdown

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Productivity and Business Processes (Office 365, LinkedIn, Dynamics 365) generated $77,340 million, while More Personal Computing contributed $62,420 million. Total operating expenses were $58,850 million, leading to operating income of $109,430 million and net income of $88,140 million ($11.80 diluted EPS). Consolidated balance sheet total assets reached $512,160 million. Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $75,540 million.

metadata.section: Section 1: Segment Operations and Income Statement Breakdown

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $75,540 million. Property, plant, and equipment (PPE) net expanded to $134,870 million, reflecting $44,500 million in capital expenditures primarily dedicated to AI cloud data center infrastructure. Goodwill and intangible assets stood at $118,920 million following the Activision Blizzard consolidation. Total liabilities were $243,690 million and Stockholders equity reached $268,470 million.

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c0.text: NVIDIA reported total annual revenue of $60,922 million ($60.92B), representing a 126% annual expansion driven by enterprise generative AI deployment. Compute & Networking segment generated $47,405 million, propelled by NVIDIA Hopper H100 and HGX platform deployments. Graphics segment (GeForce gaming and professional visualization) contributed $13,517 million. Gross margin expanded to 72.7% ($44,301 million gross profit).

metadata.section: Section 1: Financial Results and Hyper-Scale AI Data Center Revenue

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c1.text: Gross margin expanded to 72.7% ($44,301 million gross profit). Total operating expenses were $11,329 million (R&D of $8,675 million). Operating income surged to $32,972 million (54.1% operating margin), resulting in consolidated net income of $29,760 million ($11.93 diluted EPS). Total balance sheet assets reached $65,728 million, up from $41,182 million in the prior fiscal period.

metadata.section: Section 1: Financial Results and Hyper-Scale AI Data Center Revenue

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c2.text: Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $25,984 million. Inventories were $5,282 million, consisting of raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods. Outstanding inventory purchase obligations and long-term supply agreements with semiconductor foundries (TSMC) totaled $16,100 million to secure wafer manufacturing capacity. Total stockholders equity expanded to $42,978 million.

metadata.section: Section 2: Working Capital, Inventory Commitments and Balance Sheet

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c3.text: Total stockholders equity expanded to $42,978 million. R&D expenditures for semiconductor integrated circuit masks and tape-outs are expensed as incurred until technological feasibility is proven.

TSLA_Tesla_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c0_.text: Tesla reported total annual revenues of $96,773 million ($96.77B), representing 19% growth year-over-year. Automotive segment revenue reached $82,419 million, including $1,790 million from zero-emission regulatory credits. Energy generation and storage (Megapack and Powerwall) grew 54% to $6,035 million. Services and other revenue contributed $8,319 million.

metadata.section: Section 1: Automotive Revenues, Energy Generation & Operating Income

TSLA_Tesla_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c1_.text: Services and other revenue contributed $8,319 million. Total automotive cost of revenues was $65,121 million, resulting in total gross profit of $17,660 million (18.2% gross margin). Total operating expenses were $8,769 million (R&D $3,969 million), producing operating income of $8,891 million and net income of $14,997 million. Total balance sheet assets reached $106,618 million.

metadata.section: Section 1: Automotive Revenues, Energy Generation & Operating Income

Net property, plant, and equipment reached $29,725 million, reflecting expansion across Gigafactory Texas, Berlin, and Shanghai. Total debt and finance leases excluding vehicle financing were $2,857 million.
